title: Chickpea Coconut Curry
description: Comforting chickpeas in a gently spiced coconut sauce.

cooking_instructions.text: Soften the chopped onion in a large pot.
Stir in the curry paste for one minute.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk and simmer for 20 minutes.
Fold in the spinach until it wilts, then serve with rice.
